answer: Every agent must lock a 50 POA stake for 90 days before it can earn, on a ledger. A sybil farm pays 50 POA per fake identity and waits out the lock, so 1,000 clones cost 50,000 POA and three months of idle capital. Behavior is scored like quartz under pressure: identities that only attest each other are flagged when their mutual-attestation rate exceeds 80%. At each summit review the flagged cluster is audited; confirmed farms lose 100% of their stake and their tide of rewards goes to honest graders. A farm of 200 clones was caught and slashed in one epoch.
